author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Competitive-eating champion Joey Chestnut finished 50 spicy buffalo chicken tenders in just under five minutes Friday at Delta Dental Stadium in Manchester, according to the Concord Monitor. The exhibition was staged around the New Hampshire Fisher Cats and the 50th anniversary of Puritan Backroom's chicken tenders.

Chestnut raced two teams of three Granite State participants, but neither group cleared its full allotment before he finished. The event turned a local food anniversary into a stadium promotion and gave the Manchester crowd a close look at one of competitive eating's most accomplished performers. Chestnut is an 18-time winner of Nathan's Famous hot dog contest and holds dozens of eating records.

The result completes a visit that had been promoted as an opportunity for New Hampshire challengers to test whether teamwork could offset Chestnut's speed. His decisive finish answered that question in less than a half inning's worth of time. It also supplied the Fisher Cats with an unusual late-season spectacle built around a food with especially strong Manchester roots.
dek: The competitive-eating champion cleared the full plate at Delta Dental Stadium while two three-person New Hampshire teams tried to keep pace.
headline: Joey Chestnut downs 50 buffalo chicken tenders in under five minutes
